21.description: The Committee recommends City Council reaffirm its leadership in the Homelessness Action Plan 2026, endorsing performance indicators to monitor progress and address the city's growing homelessness crisis.

chips.text: Previous homelessness plans have not produced measurable results despite significant funding.
Administration clarified City Council is not endorsing rent control
Councillor questioned why the number of homeless people is not a key performance indicator.
Citizen encouraged a rapid deployment triage team to support emergency services.
Committee moved to require annual progress reports and a full plan review every four years.

19.description: Council received verbal updates from its members and various boards, committees, and commissions following a private committee meeting.
